purpose: Prepare a separately implemented offline reproduction of the complete June 28 confirmation decision from the exact retained artifact bytes and immutable identities

existing_embedded_verifier.permitted_use: compare independently calculated results after all clean-room gates finish
omissions: ZIP provider identity and complete inventory
immutable dependency hashes and execution identity
reservation, receipt, result and terminal-state reconciliation
official team-ID derivation and raw-pair contradictions
full plate zone/chase and automatic-pitch identities
complete EV/launch-angle denominator identities and official PA denominator
attempt-state succession and total real request accounting

required_external_inputs.artifact_retrieval_receipt: schema-versioned provider-observed artifact ID, name, run, creation, expiration, retrieval UTC, source URL identity without credentials, ZIP bytes and ZIP SHA-256; exact receipt SHA bound by execution authorization
required_external_inputs.post_terminal_run_receipt: schema-versioned provider-observed run 30846344146 attempt 1, dispatch commit, event, actor, terminal failure conclusion, created/start/update/completion times; exact receipt SHA bound by execution authorization
required_external_inputs.append_only_successor_attempt_ledger: schema-versioned predecessor-bound state preserving July attempts 1-3 consumed, old July attempt 4 unused/unauthorized, June attempt 1 consumed with exact run/artifact/one-request/no-rerun identities, total real requests four; exact SHA bound by execution authorization
required_external_inputs.attempt_incident_or_terminal_adjudicatio: schema-versioned exact terminal evidence/disposition record; exact SHA bound by execution authorization
required_external_inputs.official_pa_denominator_receipt: schema-versioned receipt whose exact 15 per-game totals are recomputed from the separately hash-bound certified official-PA source; must not be derived from Statcast distinct at_bat_number values; exact SHA bound by execution authorization
required_external_inputs.official_pa_source: schema-versioned exact certified official-date/game/team-side source bytes with home and away plate appearances; its externally adjudicated source-release identity and exact file SHA-256 must be bound by execution authorization
required_external_inputs.official_pa_certified_release: exact certified release bytes whose SHA-256 is bound externally and must equal the source and receipt release identity
required_external_inputs.official_pa_independent_verifier: exact separate verifier bytes whose SHA-256 is bound externally and must equal the receipt verifier identity
required_external_inputs.durable_retention_receipt: separate gate; not required to calculate reproduction but required before any source-qualification review

recalculation_requirements: ZIP CRC, duplicate-name, traversal, absolute-path, symlink, encryption and exact-inventory checks
raw byte count and SHA-256 without reconstruction
reservation, receipt, result, timestamps, URL, headers, HTTP 200, one request, no redirects, retries, replacements or reruns
UTF-8 BOM, HTML, JSON and Savant error signatures, newline convention and clean EOF
exact ordered 119-column header, row width, malformed and empty rows
positive game, at-bat, pitch, batter and pitcher identities and no duplicate event
exact date, regular-season game type, exact 15-game universe and both batting sides
canonical batting and fielding official team IDs derived from certified game_pk, date and side while preserving raw labels
all plate-description categories, zone/chase opportunities and swings, missing and invalid zones
complete BBE, EV, launch-angle, joint, missing, classified, barrel, hard-hit, sweet-spot and upper-tail denominators
official PA denominator from a separately hash-bound certified receipt
known_pre_execution_blockers: immutable external artifact-retrieval receipt is not yet repository-bound
post-terminal GitHub run receipt is not yet repository-bound
append-only post-attempt successor ledger and incident/adjudication record are absent
hash-bound official PA denominator receipt is absent
hash-bound certified official-PA source bytes are absent
hash-bound certified source release and separate PA-verifier bytes are absent
separate reproduction execution authorization has not been granted

decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_PASSED: every recalculation and immutable identity passes, every material primary claim agrees, all required external receipts and post-attempt state are present, mutation tests fail closed, and the no-overwrite report is preserved
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_INCOMPLETE: any required input, receipt, state transition, denominator or gate is absent
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_FAILED: any identity, byte, schema, scope, calculation or disposition contradiction exists
decision_rule.overall_source_qualification: remains prohibited unless separate durable retention is verified and a later separately authorized activation review accepts both gates

prohibited_actions: feature construction, model fitting, scoring, prediction, evaluation or betting
